rank_definition: (average transcriptome rank - 1)/(number of common host features - 1), centered at0.5
source_shared_mask: Union of expression-supported genes across the canonical cell identities already declared for inference in that source; use the SAME mask for all its cell identities, permitting composition sensitivity without cell-specific score definitions
gene_support: >=10% detected cells in >=3 units within any declared canonical identity; same primary gene-Z reference; no new core membership
